headline_marked: Security vacuum fears as [[US forces exit Iraq]]
headline: Security vacuum fears as US forces exit Iraq
summary: The withdrawal marks the end of a 23-year military presence, raising concerns about the resurgence of Islamic State and the influence of Iranian-backed militias.
details: US forces withdrew from their remaining bases in Iraq on Wednesday, ending a military presence that began 23 years ago with the toppling of Saddam Hussein.
The move, agreed upon in 2024 under President Joe Biden and executed by the Trump administration, is seen as a victory by Tehran and its allies.
Analysts warn that the departure creates a security vacuum that could embolden Iranian-backed militias to expand their role in shaping state policies.
There are also fears that the resurgent Islamic State group could use the absence of Western military presence to regroup and launch new attacks.
US troops had previously provided critical intelligence, aerial surveillance, and reconnaissance to help Iraqi security forces fight the militants.
Iraqi security officials worry that the country lacks sufficient air defense capabilities to counter threats like armed drones from Islamic State.
Over 20 years of war in Iraq, approximately 4,500 American service members were killed.
The withdrawal comes after a years-long counterinsurgency effort against Saddam loyalists, al-Qaeda, and later the Islamic State.
caption:
After 23 years of war and 4,500 American deaths, US forces have officially left Iraq.

US forces withdrew from their remaining bases in Iraq on Wednesday, ending a military presence that began 23 years ago with the toppling of Saddam Hussein.

The move, agreed upon in 2024 under President Joe Biden and executed by the Trump administration, is seen as a victory by Tehran and its allies.

Analysts warn that the departure creates a security vacuum that could embolden Iranian-backed militias to expand their role in shaping state policies.

There are also fears that the resurgent Islamic State group could use the absence of Western military presence to regroup and launch new attacks.

US troops had previously provided critical intelligence, aerial surveillance, and reconnaissance to help Iraqi security forces fight the militants.

Iraqi security officials worry that the country lacks sufficient air defense capabilities to counter threats like armed drones from Islamic State.

Over 20 years of war in Iraq, approximately 4,500 American service members were killed.

The withdrawal comes after a years-long counterinsurgency effort against Saddam loyalists, al-Qaeda, and later the Islamic State.

headline_marked: 234 posts available: [[Biman Bangladesh Airlines recruits for 13 categories]]
headline: 234 posts available: Biman Bangladesh Airlines recruits for 13 categories
summary: The national carrier has released a recruitment notice for various technical and management roles, with applications open until October 20, 2026.
details: Biman Bangladesh Airlines has announced a large-scale recruitment drive for 234 positions across 13 different categories.

The vacancies include roles such as Assistant Manager (Hangar - Electrical/Mechanical), Assistant Manager (Training - Operations Technical), and Assistant Manager (Training - Passenger/Cargo Sales and Management Development).
Technical roles such as Aircraft Mechanic (Line and Base Maintenance) are also available among the listed vacancies.
Interested candidates can apply online through the the official Teletalk website at http://bbal.teletalk.com.bd.
The airline has cautioned that since recruitment exams for different posts may be held on the same day, candidates are advised not to apply for multiple positions at their own risk.
The deadline for submitting applications is October 20, 2026.
caption:
Looking for a career in aviation? Biman Bangladesh Airlines is hiring for 234 positions across 13 categories!

Biman Bangladesh Airlines has announced a large-scale recruitment drive for 234 positions across 13 different categories.

The vacancies include roles such as Assistant Manager (Hangar - Electrical/Mechanical), Assistant Manager (Training - Operations Technical), and Assistant Manager (Training - Passenger/Cargo Sales and Management Development).

Technical roles such as Aircraft Mechanic (Line and Base Maintenance) are also available among the listed vacancies.

Interested candidates can apply online through the the official Teletalk website at http://bbal.teletalk.com.bd.

The airline has cautioned that since recruitment exams for different posts may be held on the same day, candidates are advised not to apply for multiple positions at their own risk.

The deadline for submitting applications is October 20, 2026.
